text: An incident report isn't written to relive the firefight for people who were there. It's a durable record for a reader who wasn't — a future on-call engineer, a new hire, or Theo himself in six months.

The timeline runs from the sale going live, through the first alert at T plus one-thirty, through root-cause identification, through the fix, to confirmed sustained recovery at T plus two-fifty-five — about eighty-five minutes of real customer impact.

The root cause names the actual mechanism: a missing topology spread constraint on checkout-api, masked by the FinOps dashboard's cluster-wide average. What went right gets credited too — the reliability dashboard's independence is exactly what caught it.
Every follow-up action gets a named owner and a real deadline, including adding a per-AZ breakdown panel to the FinOps dashboard. Next lesson: building that panel.
